The harness `boot`/`status`/`cleanup` paths are exercised by   `crates/viola-e2e/tests/cli.rs` and `harness_lifecycle.rs` inside `run --integration`. - **Separate target dirs.** Cargo runs that could collide with a running exe keep the harness's own `CARGO_TARGET_DIR`   (host-win32 §Session Additions 2026-09-24). - **Local only:** the three `metrics.py` entries and the viola-core mutation entry are host-tool measurements (tokei, rust-code-analysis,   jscpd, cargo-mutants), not CI jobs. - **CI witnesses** the Linux/macOS halves and the ubuntu mutation leg plus union on the pushed sha, read by the operator entries at the   end. The CI `lint` job carries `scripts/lint-probes.sh` (ubuntu) and the orphans gate. The `test` job carries the per-OS coverage floors   (per test-plan §10 Coverage thresholds). - **One-shot mutating controls at /implement (never gate entries).** The light gate re-runs entries verbatim, so no entry edits   source.
